title: MA61028: Boundary Integral Methods
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Partial Differential EquationsGreen s function of Laplace
equation in 1-d, 2-d and 3-d; Green s function of Helmholtz equation; Integral
representation, Hypersingular integrals; Boundary element discretization;
Generalized single and double layer representations; Boundary element
collocation method, higher order collocation methods; Three node flat
triangles, six node curved triangles; Inhomogeneous, nonlinear, and time
dependent problems; Applications in axisymmetric fields, viscous flows, Navieer
â Stokes and non-Newtonian flows; BEMLIB exercises.
